Reset Journal
You're in a reset. Be kind to yourself — this is built into the method.
💭 What actually happened? Was I demotivated or overwhelmed?
🌀 Did the vice spiral? Start small and grow?
⚡ What was the trigger? Stress, boredom, avoidance?
Log History
1
Identity: Tech Sober
Decide who you are. You are someone who is not controlled by technology or impulses. This is identity-level — not a rule, not a restriction. You simply are that person now. Say it: "I am tech sober."
2
Cold Turkey
Don't rely on app blockers — the point is to say no to yourself. If it's too hard, tier down — books, podcasts, walks instead of Reddit or Reels. Lower stimulation, not zero stimulation.
3
Meditate
Sit with yourself. Even 5 minutes of stillness. The goal is to reduce baseline stimulation so your nervous system can settle into focus.
3.5
Observe Feelings (Do Nothing)
Sit with boredom. Don't escape it, don't fix it, just notice it. Your brain learns that discomfort is survivable. Allow a Tier 3 vice if really needed.
4
Ideal Dose
Set the conditions for when you'll allow vices. Some people do 1 full day per week rather than a little every day. Decide your version. The key: planned, not reactive.
5
Ramp Up & Binge
You faltered. Now — blame the vice, not yourself. The vice is engineered to be addictive. You're not weak. Say out loud: "That thing pulled me in. It's designed to." Don't spiral — redirect.
6
Reset
Journal through what happened. Process and move forward. The reset is part of the method — not a failure of it.
7
Productivity Burst ✦
After a few cycles, you'll feel a burst of genuine motivation. When it comes — work until you want to stop. Do not force yourself beyond it or you'll create an expectancy gap.

After a good session, do pinning: say "Yes! That felt lovely." Anchor the good feeling.
Pinning reminder:
"Yes — that felt good. I did the work. That's who I am."
Your Vice Tiers
Categorise your vices by stimulation level. Tier down gradually — not cold turkey to nothing.
🔴 Tier 1 — High
TikTok, Reddit, IG scrolling…
🟡 Tier 2 — Medium
YouTube vlogs, casual games…
🟢 Tier 3 — Low
Books, podcasts, TED-Ed, walks…
